annotations.title: Is the image or article at this link AI?

description: Check a public web page or file URL for AI: fetches it and reads AI labels, AI-use statements, Content Credentials and saved creation records found there, with an AI-likelihood score for the image. Use for: is this article, news photo, product image or social post AI-generated or fake? Logins, paywalls and CAPTCHAs are not bypassed. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp
